title: Identification and Honest Recovery from Semantic Observation Kernels: Operator Error, Coarsening, and Stability
abstract: arXiv:2607.23130v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Probabilistic text generators, such as large language models, assign probabilities to phrases, but consequential decisions require posterior uncertainty over meaningful states. These are not interchangeable: language probabilities depend on the prompt, may be incomplete and need not reliably identify state uncertainty. Without a statistical bridge, fluent responses and numerical confidence are insufficient for inference or governance.   We formulate recovery of the target posterior as a semiparametric inverse problem and develop honest recovery guarantees that account jointly for calibration error, measurement noise, incomplete probabilities and weak identification. Simulations demonstrate the predicted coverage and stability behaviour, while two frozen language-model studies demonstrate held-out recovery. translated_title: 语义观测核的识别与诚实恢复：算子误差、粗化与稳定性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.23130v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：概率文本生成器，如大型语言模型，为短语分配概率，但关键决策需要关于有意义状态的后验不确定性。这两者不可互换：语言概率依赖于提示，可能不完整，且无需可靠地识别状态不确定性。没有统计桥梁，流畅的响应和数值置信度不足以进行推断或治理。我们将目标后验的恢复构建为半参数逆问题，并开发了诚实的恢复保证，这些保证联合考虑了校准误差、测量噪声、不完整概率和弱识别。模拟展示了预测的覆盖率和稳定性行为，而两项冻结语言模型研究展示了保留数据的恢复。所提出的方法确定了语义测量何时可信任用于推断，以及何时需要使用、审查、重新校准。
tldr: 本文提出了一种半参数逆问题方法，通过联合处理校准误差、测量噪声和弱识别，实现了从语义观测中诚实恢复目标后验，并确定了语义测量的可信度边界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a semiparametric inverse problem approach that honestly recovers the target posterior from semantic observations by jointly addressing calibration error, measurement noise, and weak identification, and determines when semantic measurements can be trusted for inference.
